title: Enterprise Agricultural & Food Supply-Chain Commodity Procurement, Satellite SAR/NDVI Yield Forecasting & Stochastic CVaR Hedging Agent

tiers.tier: Tier 1: USDA/Gov Monthly Lagged Reports + 5-Year Historical Moving Average Excel
tiers.architecture: Waiting for lagged monthly official crop reports (30–45 day delay) + fixed quarterly mechanical forward buying in Excel

tiers.tier: Tier 2: Prompt-Only General LLM Commodity News Sentiment Trader
tiers.architecture: Feeding financial news headlines into GPT-4o / Claude to recommend futures positions without satellite crop physics or basis-risk constraints

tiers.tier: Tier 3: Optical-Only Satellite NDVI Regression (Sentinel-2 / MODIS Only)
tiers.architecture: Optical vegetative indices (NDVI/EVI) without C-band radar cloud penetration, vapor-pressure deficit (VPD) flower-abortion physics, or CVaR basis constraints

tiers.tier: Tier 4: Sentinel-1 SAR + Sentinel-2 NDVI Fusion + ECMWF Agro-Physics + CVaR Basis Hedging + Silo Dew-Point Agent
tiers.architecture: All-Weather C-Band SAR (VV/VH) + Optical NDVI/SIF + ECMWF 51-Member Ensemble VPD Stress + Two-Stage Stochastic CVaR Futures/Physical Solver + Silo Equilibrium Moisture Gate

scenarios.scenario: 28-Day Tropical Monsoon Cloud Cover Over Mato Grosso Soybean / Minas Gerais Coffee Belt
scenarios.question: Estimate pod-filling biomass and harvest delay during 4 consecutive weeks of 90% opaque cloud cover when optical Sentinel-2 NDVI is completely blinded
scenarios.model_answer: Fuse Sentinel-1 C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (VH/VV backscatter ratio) + SMAP root-zone soil moisture to track canopy structure through clouds (0-day blind gap)
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 3 optical-only NDVI pipeline returns NaN/cloud-masked pixels for 24 days, missing a -14% waterlogging yield drop until prices already surge +22%.

scenarios.scenario: Green-Canopy Illusion During Flowering Heatwave (High NDVI but Extreme Vapor Pressure Deficit VPD > 3.2 kPa)
scenarios.question: Leaves remain green (NDVI = 0.78) during a 5-day 39°C flowering heatwave; predict grain-set abortion 6 weeks before harvest
scenarios.model_answer: Couple ECMWF 51-member ensemble VPD + ECOSTRESS canopy evaporative stress index into phenological stage model; flag -18.5% pollen sterilization yield shock
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 3 pure NDVI regression sees lush green leaves (0.78) and predicts bumper crop (+9.6% error), leaving physical procurement unhedged.

scenarios.scenario: Cross-Hedge Basis Risk Explosion (ICE/CBOT Futures vs. Local Physical Origin Port Differential)
scenarios.question: Hedge 45,000 MT of specialty cocoa/coffee where local port differentials diverge from ICE futures during regional export congestion
scenarios.model_answer: Solve two-stage stochastic CVaR_95 optimization balancing ICE futures, OTC basis swaps, and multi-origin physical forward contracts under margin-call liquidity bounds
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 2 LLM recommends 100% naive futures hedge, triggering a $1.4M margin call when futures spike while local physical basis collapses.

scenarios.scenario: Post-Harvest Grain Silo Condensation & Aflatoxin / Ochratoxin Spoilage Prevention
scenarios.question: Control aeration fans across 80 grain silos (14.6% moisture corn/coffee) when ambient night humidity hits 88% RH
scenarios.model_answer: Compute Henderson Equilibrium Moisture Content (EMC) & headspace dew-point differential; lock out humid night intake and trigger dehumidified aeration before fungal growth
scenarios.tier1_3_failure: Tier 1 timer-based aeration blows 88% RH night air into warm grain, pushing EMC above 15.5% and spoiling a $320K silo batch with aflatoxin.

key_findings: Tier 4 (Sentinel-1 C-Band SAR + Sentinel-2 NDVI + ECMWF Ensemble Agro-Physics + Stochastic CVaR Hedging) slashes regional crop yield MAPE 8 weeks pre-harvest from 16.8% to 2.9%.
Fusing all-weather microwave SAR backscatter (VH/VV) with root-zone soil moisture eliminates the 24–38 day monsoon cloud blindness of optical-only NDVI models (0.0 blind days).

Pairing phenological VPD heat-stress modeling with a two-stage CVaR futures/basis solver and Henderson EMC silo aeration control cuts monthly procurement variance and spoilage loss from $620K to $58K (-90.6%).
